# runr_runtime_source (Data Source)

A runtime source ([runtime sources](https://runr.sh/docs/runtimes/#runtime-sources)) and the runtimes it gives, each with its lifecycle: any source the token sees (`runtimes.manage`: every one; `runtimes.use_custom`: the organization's), RunR's own catalog of built-in runtimes too (`name = "RunR runtimes"`, `is_default`). Look it up by `name` or `id`. A report to read, e.g. to check that a source was read (`status`) or to pick a runtime id for `runr_project.runtime`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# RunR's own catalog of built-in runtimes.
data "runr_runtime_source" "runr" {
  name = "RunR runtimes"
}

# A connected source and the runtimes it gives, with their lifecycle.
data "runr_runtime_source" "acme" {
  name = "acme-runtimes"
}

output "deprecated_runtimes" {
  value = [for rt in data.runr_runtime_source.acme.runtimes : "${rt.id} (sunset ${coalesce(rt.sunset_at, "-")}, use ${coalesce(rt.replacement, "-")})" if rt.state != "active"]
}

check "builtin_catalog" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.runr_runtime_source.runr.status == "ok"
    error_message = "RunR's catalog was not read: ${coalesce(data.runr_runtime_source.runr.error, data.runr_runtime_source.runr.status)}"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Source id.
- `name` (String) Source name (any case).

### Read-Only

- `checked_at` (String) When RunR last read the source.
- `credentials` (Attributes) Which credentials the source has (never a value). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `enabled` (Boolean) RunR reads the source on its interval.
- `error` (String) Why the last read failed.
- `interval_minutes` (Number) Minutes between reads.
- `is_default` (Boolean) RunR's own catalog (the built-in runtimes).
- `kind` (String) `git` or `oci-catalog`.
- `patch_feed` (String) The source's runtime patch feed.
- `path` (String) `git`: directory of the runtimes.
- `problems` (Attributes List) The problems of the last read. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--problems))
- `public_key` (String) cosign public key the catalog must verify with.
- `ref` (String) `git`: branch, tag or commit.
- `registry_host` (String) Registry the registry credentials are for.
- `revision` (String) Catalog digest or commit of the last good read.
- `runtimes` (Attributes List) The runtimes of the source, each with its lifecycle ([lifecycle](https://runr.sh/docs/runtimes/#lifecycle)). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runtimes))
- `runtimes_count` (Number) Runtimes the source gives.
- `scope` (String) `platform` or `organization`.
- `signature_verified` (Boolean) The last read's catalog verified.
- `status` (String) The last read: `never`, `ok`, `partial`, `unreachable`, `not_found`, `auth_failed`, `invalid_signature`, `invalid_catalog` or `disabled`.
- `synced_at` (String) When the last good read was.
- `url` (String) Repository or catalog reference.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `git` (String) `token` (HTTPS), `ssh` (a deploy key) or null.
- `git_token_hint` (String) The token's last four characters behind a mask (tokens longer than eight characters).
- `git_username` (String) User name of the Git token (null: `x-access-token`).
- `known_hosts_set` (Boolean) `known_hosts` is set (without it the host key is accepted on first use).
- `registry_password_set` (Boolean) A registry password is set.
- `registry_username` (String) The registry user.
- `ssh_key_set` (Boolean) A deploy key is set.


<a id="nestedatt--problems"></a>
### Nested Schema for `problems`

Read-Only:

- `file` (String) The file.
- `message` (String) The problem.
- `path` (String) JSON path in the manifest.
- `runtime` (String) The runtime id or directory.


<a id="nestedatt--runtimes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runtimes`

Read-Only:

- `deprecated_at` (String) Deprecated from this date.
- `id` (String) Runtime id (`runr_project.runtime`).
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `notice` (String) Why it is deprecated or sunset.
- `orphaned_at` (String) When it left its source.
- `path` (String) Its directory in the source.
- `projects_count` (Number) Projects that use it.
- `replacement` (String) The runtime RunR suggests instead.
- `state` (String) `active`, `deprecated`, `sunset` or `orphaned`.
- `sunset_at` (String) After this date its projects can no longer be created, saved or deployed.
- `versions` (Attributes List) Its versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runtimes--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--runtimes--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runtimes.versions`

Read-Only:

- `deprecated_at` (String) Deprecated from this date.
- `ends_at` (String) The earlier of `eol_at` and `sunset_at`: the version leaves the picker, its projects can no longer be saved or deployed.
- `eol_at` (String) End of life.
- `is_default` (Boolean) The default version.
- `state` (String) `active`, `deprecated`, `eol` or `sunset`.
- `sunset_at` (String) Sunset.
- `version` (String) Version.
